_comment: Njordlinger Combat Gameplay Overhaul - soul stones (PLAN.md phase 4, D17-D22; WORD-TABLE.md). Every number is a TUNE
default (WORD-TABLE.md 'First numbers', for Fable's review). tools/PluginBuild turns this into records; the SKSE plugin
Cell kinds: rec = the composed enchantment's effect does it (contact on a weapon, constant on armour); perk = a perk of
entry points the SKSE plugin gives the player while the item is equipped, its value set by the stone's tier; self = an
ability spell the plugin gives the player while the item is equipped; proc = the plugin's event handler (hit, hit-by,
kill) casts or applies something; grant = the armour reading of a Shout-only phrase (D21); stub = not built yet (the
item card still shows the effect line so the slot is never silent). approx marks a stand-in for the written effect.
m / dur / mult / add: one number, or [petty, grand] interpolated linearly across the five tiers. chance: a fixed
percent (the tier scales strength, not chance). Phrases do not scale with tier (WORD-TABLE.md).

Phrases with an 'external' Shout (Stormcrown, its Wyrmstooth patch) are soft links: no master; the SKSE plugin resolves the Shout at load and the phrase is unavailable when the plugin is absent. A word may belong to several phrases; its cells are defined once, where it first appears.
lootListsRetired: D22 revised (STONE-CRAFTING.md, 2026-10-26): lootLists and vendorLists are no longer injected (stones are neither loot nor merchandise); the levelled lists stay in the plugin so no form ID moves

dust._comment: D22 revised (STONE-CRAFTING.md 2): five MISC items, one per tier; value half the empty gem's; the model and sounds of bone meal. Built LATE (after every earlier record) so no form ID moves.

drops._comment: D29 (DESIGN-RETHINK.md 14, the owner 20:56, TUNE Q80): in every game, a kill by the player or a follower - a dragon drops the three stones of one Shout on its spell list (grand from level 40, else greater); a named boss (the Boss location ref type, or a keyword below) at level 30+ drops one stone at 25% (grand from 40, else greater). Nobody else drops stones. Runtime, no levelled lists.

addSlot._comment: ENCHANTING-OFF.md 7 (the owner 20:14, TUNE Q77): Thorvar raises an item's stone slots up to three, in both modes; each added slot costs one orichalcum ingot and one soul gem (filled or empty) sized by which added slot it is - lesser for the item's first added slot, greater for the second, grand for the third.

craft._comment: STONE-CRAFTING.md 3 (TUNE; the owner 23:11): one orichalcum ingot is cut into three Rune Blanks; a stone takes one blank plus dust of its tier; only words learned at a wall. The blank is built at the very end of the plugin so no form ID moves.
